problems.condition: Consolidation, Lesson 2, упр. 1, с. 62. 1) Ответь на вопросы о дневном лагере; 2) верно / неверно; 3) весело ли детям в лагере.
steps: 1) Ann and Kirk are at the Day Camp. They spend 5 days there — from the 15th to the 19th of July. On Monday Kirk went climbing, played games, went to the circus and sang karaoke.
2) That's right! That's wrong — there is a river near the camp. That's wrong — the children spend 5 days. That's right! That's right! That's right!
3) I think children have fun at the Day Camp: they play games, swim, watch cartoons, play football, read and sing.
